name: Pizza Trolley
notes: All 3 photos are legible menu boards for this food truck (Pizza Trolley), from apparently different events with some price drift for overlapping items. Merged unique items from photo 1 (chalkboard sandwich board: pizzas, salads/subs, munchies) and photo 3 (orange branded sandwich board: specialty pizzas, desserts, wings/pretzel). Photo 2 (printed flyer) duplicated photo 1's pizza/salad names at different prices, so it was skipped to avoid conflicting entries for the same dish. Pollo Alfredo's price was covered by a sticker in photo 3 and omitted rather than guessed.
